response.overview: In his full-length stand-up comedy special FIR, seasoned comedian Maheep Singh delivers a candid and unfiltered take on the quirks, absurdities, and unspoken realities of aging. Living alone in a spacious Golf Course Road apartment, Maheep reflects on his solitary bachelor lifestyle, awkward dating experiences, and the ever-growing generation gap between Gen Z and older generations. Through sharp observation and dark humor, he navigates bizarre family encounters—from superstitious siblings giving unsolicited medical advice to the unique trials of managing everyday health issues. He also dives into the funny dynamic between men and women, the absurdity of modern relationships, and the subtle, overlooked hypocrisy found in societal norms and pet parenting. Blending relatable storytelling with his signature dry wit, FIR offers an honest, hilarious look at adult life, loneliness, and the chaotic beauty of growing older.
response.tagline: "Growing old is mandatory. Growing up is optional."
response.title: Maheep Singh: F.I.R.
